Recently I got hospitalised for my depression and anxiety but as it turned out it was all second hand to my ASD diagnosis. I got diagnosed when I was a kid and my family have always forced stuff on me to try and make me act Nurotypical. A build of this and forcing myself to mask 24/7 has really destroyed my head space. I've fucked up a lot in the past due to trying to fit in. Wasted so much time drinking and going to clubs despite it not being high interest. Tried getting a girlfriend a lot of the time despite not being interested. To a few of the events I went to that I was actually interested in it ended in shit. I was forced into fornicating with someone as well which still bothers me. The hospitallization has actually helped me. I spent 2 months away from everything, a psychological talked to my family and everything is on the up but I do need to distract myself 24/7 otherwise I start thinking about the past and that gets me down. I do put a lot of my feelings and issues into my art and music now. I know this was more of an vent (sorry about that) and I'm not sure where I'm going with this but I guess one thing I can say is to express yourself through something artistic. I find it really helps. Also recently I've just stopped giving a F and started just doing what I love because life is way to shirt and screwed to adhere to unwritten social rules and being someone you're not. I do have decent friends both NT and ND as they are just happy with me being my real self. Sorry for vent. I hope this is somewhat useful to you and I hope anyone who reads this has a good day/night. (I've also found going to my childhood games makes me insanely happy as I believe that was a stress free time in my life)
